text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, where a computer can identify what is shown in a picture, such as a cat or a flower. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating multiple objects within an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to recognise traffic signs, other vehicles, and pedestrians. It also helps doctors examine medical images and allows phones to unlock using your face. As technology improves, computer vision will become even more common.
